references.text: Command regarding pure oil for the lampstand, the same regulation repeated from Exodus
Description of the lampstand (menorah) that the oil was to keep burning
Aaron shall tend the lamps every morning and evening, showing the daily service with the light
Instructions about the lamps on the lampstand that were to shine forward
Samuel served before the Lord where God's lamp was, showing the continuous burning of the lamp in the sanctuary
The lampstand with its lamps lit every evening shows the continuation of this practice in the temple
Jesus speaks about being the light of the world, fulfilling the symbolism of the eternal light in the tabernacle
Jesus declares himself to be the light of the world, a fulfillment of the lamp's symbolism in the sanctuary
John sees seven golden lampstands with the Son of Man in the midst, linking back to the tabernacle's lampstand
Thematic parallel: The principle of continuous offering (daily burnt offering) involving oil.
